_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Your impact begins here

Shape how Enterprise AI priorities are translated into measurable value across Novo Nordisk. As Director, Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value, you will lead the team connecting business demand, portfolio decisions and committed outcomes. You will create a transparent view of Enterprise AI activity and help senior business, product and Finance stakeholders make clear choices about value, cost and capacity. Your leadership will strengthen how the organisation priorities, governs and tracks its AI investments.

What you’ll bring

You are a leader who creates clarity in a complex global organisation, develops capable teams and brings senior stakeholders together around shared priorities. You combine strategic portfolio leadership with a practical understanding of digital and AI delivery.

• Significant experience in enterprise portfolio management, digital or AI transformation, strategy or business partnering, including leadership of a team or function.

• A proven ability to lead and develop people, set clear expectations and enable specialists to deliver across organisational boundaries.

• Experience shaping enterprise priorities with senior business and product leaders, resolving trade-offs and aligning digital portfolios across multiple business domains.

• Proven experience establishing value frameworks and benefits tracking with business owners and Finance, supported by evidence-based executive reporting.

• Experience building demand-intake and prioritisation practices that turn business needs into clear initiatives with accountable owners and agreed outcomes.

• A relevant master’s degree in business, engineering, technology, data, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

You will also bring a practical understanding of Data and AI and broader digital product lifecycles, including discovery, rapid prototyping, delivery, adoption, value measurement, responsible AI and risk considerations. Fluent written and spoken English is essential. Experience from life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry would be useful, but is not essential.

What you’ll do

• Lead and develop the Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value team, establishing clear priorities and accountabilities while building the team’s capabilities.

• Own the end-to-end Enterprise AI portfolio, providing a transparent view across domain AI use cases, rapid prototyping and Data and AI Platform capability development.

• Scale the Enterprise AI value framework, agreeing value commitments, measures and benefits tracking with business owners and Finance.

• Oversee demand intake, prioritisation and routing, aligning business stakeholders and product teams on which opportunities to initiate, postpone or redirect.

• Connect Enterprise AI with digital portfolios across the business, balancing value, cost and capacity to support investment and resource decisions.

• Own portfolio governance and monthly value reporting to Enterprise AI and executive leadership, ensuring reliable data, clear decisions and an evidence-based value narrative.

You will also support value tracking connected with key strategic partners. This will involve working with partnership owners, business stakeholders and Finance to agree expected outcomes and report progress.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Enterprise IT & Quality, a business area working across the Novo Nordisk value chain. Within Enterprise AI, you will lead the Portfolio & Value team and collaborate across business domains, AI delivery, enablement and platform teams. Your closest partners will include senior business and product leaders, business owners, Finance colleagues and partnership owners. Together, you will connect business priorities with a shared portfolio view and consistent approaches to value management and demand.

What you can expect here

This is an opportunity to shape enterprise-level decisions about where AI can create meaningful value. You will have the mandate to build clarity across a broad portfolio, strengthen governance and develop a team that works across organisational boundaries. The role combines strategic leadership, people development and close collaboration with senior stakeholders in a global environment.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800 to 1,448,700 (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy. The salary wording and placement of the pay-transparency section follow the approved guidance.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead how Enterprise AI priorities, demand and value are managed across Novo Nordisk, apply for the Director, Enterprise AI Portfolio & Value role by 1. November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

We’re looking for a Product Engineer to help us build better tools for legal research. You’ll work mainly on the backend, with a say in what we build and responsibility for taking it from an early idea to something customers use every day. That includes asking whether we’re solving the right problem, deciding what’s worth shipping first, and knowing when something needs more time.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**What We Value

**“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Mess Around. Find Out. Share What You Learned.

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

You enjoy working through a product problem while it’s still taking shape. You ask questions, share unfinished work, and help decide what’s worth building. You’re comfortable taking a feature from those early conversations through implementation, testing, and delivery.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Do you enjoy bringing out the best in people, keeping production on track and tackling the occasional curveball? Then you might be the Production Manager we're looking for.

At Aasted, we are looking for a Production Manager to lead our Combined Lines Solutions production department. You will take responsibility for a team of more than 40 employees and play an important role in creating a workplace where people thrive, work together and deliver high-quality solutions to customers around the world.

**About The Role

**As our new Production Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, performance and development of the Combined Lines Solutions production department.

Your most important responsibility will be leading and developing your team. Through clear communication, involvement and hands-on leadership, you will create the structure and motivation needed for employees to succeed.

You will report to the Head of Value Stream and work closely with 4 other competent Production Managers to ensure efficient production and timely deliveries.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead, motivate and develop a team of more than 40 production employees, with a strong focus on wellbeing, collaboration and performance.

• Ensure efficient daily production operations, including resource allocation, capacity planning and delivery performance.

• Work closely with the department's Planner to coordinate production schedules, priorities and resources.

• Monitor production performance, quality, costs and relevant KPIs, and take action when improvements are needed.

• Drive continuous improvements through structured processes, Lean principles and 5S initiatives.

• Ensure a safe working environment and compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards.

• Manage the department's production budget and contribute to efficient use of resources.

• Strengthen collaboration across production departments and other functions to ensure a smooth production flow.

• The role requires professional communication skills in both Danish and English

**About You

**We're looking for someone who knows their way around a production floor, enjoys working with people and understands that great results don't happen on their own.

You enjoy being close to the daily operations, supporting your employees and creating an environment where everyone understands their responsibilities and works towards common goals. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities and maintaining an overview, even when plans change.

You bring structure to a busy production environment and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when improvements are needed.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of management experience from a technical or industrial production environment.

• You may have a technical education or have learned your way through years of hands-on experience. What matters most is that you know production and how to lead people.

• Have a proven ability to lead, motivate and develop production teams.

• Understand production planning, capacity management and operational performance.

• Have experience with continuous improvement, preferably Lean and 5S.

• Are comfortable working with production data, KPIs and ERP systems.

• Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships across different teams and departments.

Above all, you are a leader who takes an interest in people, leads by example and takes pride in seeing your team succeed.

**About Us

**You will become part of a well-established international company with a strong Danish heritage, where relationships are highly valued. In 2026, Aasted became part of the Italian Piovan Group, opening new perspectives and opportunities as part of a larger international group in the years to come.

At Aasted, our culture is characterized by motivated employees who take pride in their work, creating a strong sense of teamwork and commitment. We value open, honest and direct communication and believe in treating people with respect and integrity in everything we do.

We continuously strive to create an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities for development for all employees. We offer an attractive parental leave scheme, social events and a nice canteen operated by Meyers Kantine.

At Aasted, we prioritize a healthy working environment and are therefore a smoke-free workplace. This means that smoking is not permitted during working hours or anywhere on company premises.

**We look forward to hearing from you

**We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV and application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions or would simply like to learn more about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Value Stream, Combined Lines Solutions, Maria Osk Sigurdardottir, at mao@aasted.eu.

At Aasted, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We therefore encourage everyone to apply, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or political and cultural background.

You can read more about us and what we do here: AASTED | Welcome to our world

**_Aasted – a Danish pioneer

_**_Aasted has been a market leader in equipment and production lines for chocolate manufacturing worldwide for more than 100 years. Our customer portfolio includes both smaller local businesses and some of the world's largest global FMCG companies.

__We are on a continuous journey driven by curiosity, which has enabled us to rethink what was previously considered possible in chocolate production. We challenge the impossible and make it possible. We continuously introduce a wide range of groundbreaking and patented solutions for our customers, helping each of them achieve their unique vision.

_At Aasted, we are more than 550 people who, through passion, experience and expertise, challenge the status quo.

_atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

__With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

__Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

__We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

__By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

_**People Transformation & Projects Lead - Help us connect strategy, people and execution

**At atNorth, growth creates a lot of opportunities. It also creates complexity.

As we continue to expand across markets, functions and countries, we need someone who can help connect the dots across the organization and turn ideas into action (and effective processes ;-) ).

We are looking for a People Transformation & Projects Lead to join our People Technology, Analytics & Process Excellence team. This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys working across organizational boundaries, solving complex challenges, manage stakeholders and driving meaningful change.

This is not a traditional P&C/HR role.

Instead, you will work at the intersection of People & Culture and other business functions where you will act as a bridge between teams, helping different stakeholders align around common goals and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into practical solutions and measurable results.

**About The Role

**Success at atNorth requires more than great ideas. It requires collaboration, alignment and execution.

As People Transformation & Projects Lead, you will help connect business needs, people, processes and technology to create solutions that work in practice.

Some days you may be leading a cross-functional project involving Operations, IT and People & Culture. Other days you may be helping leaders navigate organizational challenges, improve ways of working or implement new initiatives.

Your role is to create momentum, remove obstacles and ensure that the right people are working together towards shared outcomes.

You will be part of the People Technology, Analytics & Projects team, working closely with specialists in HR technology, analytics, AI, process development and digital transformation

**Key responsibilities -> What will you do?

****_Drive transformation initiatives

_**

• Lead projects and initiatives from identified needs and business challenges through solution design, implementation and follow-up.

• Transform ideas into tangible actions and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes.

• Drive transformation and change initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working, processes and organizational practices.

**_Connect functions and build bridges

_**

• Act as a connector across other areas as example; Operations, IT, Strategy, Finance and People & Culture.

• Bring together different perspectives, facilitate collaboration and ensure solutions work across organizational boundaries.

• Help break down silos and create stronger alignment between teams, priorities and ways of working.

**_Partner with the P&C Leadership Team

_**

• Work closely with the P&C Leadership Team to identify priorities, solve complex organizational challenges and accelerate execution of key initiatives.

• Provide structure, analysis and coordination to support decision-making and help ensure alignment between strategic objectives and operational delivery.

• Act as a sparring partner on organizational effectiveness, ways of working and business improvement opportunities.

**_Turn strategy into execution

_**

• Translate strategic priorities into practical plans and actions.

• Support leaders and stakeholders in moving from discussions and decisions to implementation and results.

**_Improve how we work & drive progress and accountability

_**

• Coordinate activities, stakeholders, timelines and dependencies across multiple initiatives.

• Support process improvements, organizational effectiveness and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Contribute to scalable ways of working that support atNorth's continued growth.

• Lead Process Excellence initiatives within People & Culture, driving the simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement of processes and ways of working to enhance efficiency, consistency, employee experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Your profile:

**You enjoy working where functions, ideas and challenges intersect and you rolemodel collaboration, accountability and a continuous improvement mindset.

You are naturally curious and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You quickly build relationships, understand different perspectives and help people find common ground.

You are equally comfortable discussing strategic priorities with senior leaders as rolling up your sleeves and contributing hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you are someone who enjoys connecting people, teams and initiatives to achieve outcomes that no single function could deliver alone.

You communicate fluent in written and spoken in at least english and other nordic languages is meriting.

You have at least 5 years of experience from the majority areas listed below:

• Transformation and change management

• Project or program management

• Management consulting

• Business improvement initiatives

• Organizational development

• HR, Operations, Technology or Strategy functions

**About the atNorth Culture

**_We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

__We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

__We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

__At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by leading people and complex technical projects and you thrive in a changing, multidisciplinary environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager of AIT Project Management to join our AIT Project Management leadership team. As a team, we are working on some of the largest and most technically complex pharma projects in Denmark, using the latest technologies across Automation and IT.

Together with the AIT Project Management leadership team, you will lead and develop a department of 15 Project Managers delivering highly technical projects in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. Your contribution will be important in ensuring high performance and employee wellbeing, while securing the right resources and competencies for our growing project portfolio.

You will work closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support business development, follow up on new opportunities and ensure the right staffing across our projects. You will also contribute to creating a positive and engaging working environment across our wider team of more than 50 highly skilled Project Managers.

Our Project Managers bring experience across Process Automation, SCADA, PLC, IT/OT, PI, PAT, MES, and automated solutions. Project execution ranges from traditional PMP-based planning and execution to agile methodologies and the use of ADO, depending on the project area and customer requirements.

How you might spend your days

As a Manager of AIT Project Management, you’ll be:

• Leading, coaching, and developing a motivated team of Project Managers, ensuring high employee engagement and wellbeing

• Ensuring the right resources and competence mix are in place to support our growth strategy and project pipeline

• Working closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support project delivery, business development, and new opportunities

• Strengthening Project Management processes within AIT and driving continuous improvements

• Supporting project execution and, when needed, taking on smaller assignments as a Project Manager

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A supportive leader who listens, provides constructive feedback, and motivates others to succeed

• Committed to ongoing coaching and the wellbeing and development of your employees

• A team player who leads by example and collaborates effectively across different areas and levels

• A strong communicator with a positive, holistic, and analytical mindset

• Structured and effective in your work, with an open and engaging management style

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or bring equivalent relevant experience

• You have at least four years of experience leading Project Managers and/or technical specialists

• You have a background as a Project Manager

• You have knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

• You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact VP of AIT Project Management Timme Traberg-Andersen +45 3079 9436.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

Are you a passionate procurement and supply chain professional with expertise in Logistics and a demonstrated track record of positively influencing across internal and external ecosystems to unlock end to end value and efficiencies to fuel sustainable growth?

As Group Category Manager – Logistics, you will report to the CPO and lead the development and execution of the Group Logistics procurement strategy across road freight including line-haul and last mile distribution, ocean freight, warehousing and related logistics services including pallets. You will combine strategic category leadership with hands-on execution, working closely with local market organisations,

The role will be based at our HQ in Faxe, Denmark.

**Main Responsibilities

**Strategy Development:

• Define and execute a multi-year procurement category strategy for Logistics that balances local execution with strategic priorities to support the group’s overarching goals.

• Leverage a strong external radar and category expertise to identify, evaluate and act on emerging opportunities and risks, i.e. external supplier landscape, commodities, industry best practices, digitalisation and automation and EU legislative environment.

**Category And Supplier Relationship Management

**

• Optimise category management processes, elevate sourcing and contract management processes, and build best practices with the market teams and stakeholders. Increase utilisation of eSourcing and development of digital tools to support cost modelling, benchmarking, and contract management.

• Develop supplier collaboration platforms with key suppliers across the group to unlock operational efficiencies, process enhancements, digital innovation, and to accelerate sustainability and circularity initiatives.

**Value Delivery, Efficiency And Business Partnering

**

• Deliver cost savings, supply chain efficiencies and carbon reduction targets. Establish ways of working with stakeholders to measure relevant KPIs, track initiatives, manage risk and deliver multiyear productivity plans.

• Ensure early engagement and alignment with relevant stakeholders on business strategy to maintain a fit for purpose and efficient logistics network driving optimal cost to serve to fuel sustainable business growth.

• Provide category leadership and inputs into on strategic projects, integration, and network optimisation.

• Streamline processes and drive digitalisation agenda.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Bachelor’s degree. Professional CIPS qualification or similar will be considered.

• Min. 8 years of relevant procurement experience in logistics categories in an international or matrixed organisation. Nordics and CPG industry experience is a plus.

• Comprehensive knowledge of procurement processes, ERP systems, procurement tools and network modelling, including a strong data analytics skillset and commodity management experience.

• Excellent communication, gravitas and influencing skills to build relationships with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Team player with a service-oriented mindset but is also not afraid to challenge the status quo or be the critical friend when required.

• Project and change management - track record for initiating and embedding change.

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands on execution.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Enthusiastic, solution-oriented approach.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

**What Success Looks Like

**Success in this role means creating a Logistics procurement organisation that is recognised as a strategic business partner, delivering measurable value beyond price reduction.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are seeking a Financial Controller to own the integrity of Tekla’s financial reporting across the group. The role combines technical control work, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation and eliminations, with ownership of a growing set of tax and trade compliance obligations spanning packaging tax, EU and global VAT and customs duties.

The Financial Controller is responsible both for meeting these obligations accurately and on time, and for building the processes, controls and automation that make them repeatable as the business scales. The role sits within an AI-first function focused on operational excellence, so we are looking for someone with a strong digital mindset and a proactive approach to using AI and automation tools to enhance reporting and improve efficiency.

This is a hands-on role, instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy and supporting Tekla's profitability and growth objectives. Reporting to the Finance Director and working closely with the Accounting Manager, the Financial Controller will also contribute to a range of ad hoc financial projects and initiatives across the function.

This is a full-time position based in our open-plan, curated office in Copenhagen.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Financial Controlling & Reporting

• Design, implement and manage the group's balance sheet reconciliations, including building standardised templates and processes across multiple entities

• Prepare the monthly and year-end group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and consolidated reporting packs

• Ensure the general ledger is supported by complete, reviewed and documented reconciliations in every period. While taking a hands-on approach to booking journals and ad hoc analysis

Tax & Trade Compliance

• Own end-to-end packaging tax obligations, including data capture, calculation and filing

• Perform compliance reviews over packaging tax, taking a proactive approach as Tekla's global footprint grows

• Analyse customs and import duties, covering tariff classification, country of origin, preferential rates and duty paid versus duty due, and identify recovery and savings opportunities.

Financial Analysis & Performance

• Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance metrics

• Perform variance and accuracy analyses to validate forecasts, budgets, and data integrity, encouraging transparency and accountability

• Investigate material variances and implement process improvements that enhance forecasting precision and analytical rigour

• Provide insightful financial analysis to support business planning, cost efficiencies and strategic priorities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance financial processes, systems, and reporting tools

• Support the automation programme within the accounting team, including Intrastat and VAT reporting

• Review and implement continual improvements in Business Central, including VAT code configuration, VAT statements and financial reports

• Strengthen documentation and controls across all owned processes so they are auditable and transferable

We'd love to hear from you if you are / have:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards and tax regulations

• Demonstrable experience of group consolidation and intercompany eliminations in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment

• Strong working knowledge of global VAT and sales tax concepts

• Exposure to packaging tax regimes is an advantage

• Experience designing and operating a balance sheet reconciliation control framework

• Confident ERP user, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Demonstrable experience using AI tools such as Claude to optimise and automate financial processes and reporting, for example building reporting dashboards, automating reconciliation and compliance workflows, or analysing large transactional data sets

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large transactional data sets

• Experience from a high-growth business within fashion, textiles or luxury consumer goods is an advantage

• An entrepreneurial mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Driving people and business success across Strategic Marketing and International Sales

As HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and leadership teams, helping translate strategy into practical people and organisational solutions. You will support two business functions, each led by its own Vice President and operating with different priorities, organisational structures and ways of working.

In this role, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability, employee engagement and business performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that people priorities are closely aligned with business goals while supporting the execution of the broader Diagnostics and global Demant people agenda.

Meet your new team and manager

The Diagnostics HR team acts as a close partner to leaders and the organisation, enabling strong performance, development and engagement across our global Diagnostics business. We work at the intersection of people, business and organisational development, ensuring that HR initiatives create value for both leaders and employees.

Our team values trust, development and continuous improvement. We combine strategic HR partnering with pragmatic execution and take pride in delivering professional, high-quality support across a diverse and international organisation.

The position is reporting to Kirsten Schmidt, Senior Director Diagnostics HR, and is based at the Demant Diagnostics Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Global HR partnering supporting a growing business area

The HR Business Partner will play a key role in supporting leaders through organisational changes, helping navigate complexity, manage stakeholder expectations and create sustainable business solutions.

You will collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels to ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Partner closely with the Vice Presidents and leadership teams within Strategic Marketing and International Sales

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on leadership, organisational and people-related matters

• Coach and challenge leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team performance

• Drive and support organisational development, capability building and change initiatives

• Drive and facilitate initiatives to ensure alignment between business priorities and global HR processes.

• Lead talent and succession discussions, supporting the identification, development and retention of key capabilities

• Use people insights and workforce data to support informed decision-making and organisational planning

In addition, you will support organisational reviews, workforce planning and employee engagement initiatives while contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Your qualifications & experience

**

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience as an HR Business Partner supporting leaders and commercial organisations in a complex business environment

• Relevant degree within human resources, business administration, organisational psychology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience advising and influencing leaders on organisational, talent and people matters

• Experience driving organisational change, leadership development and talent management initiatives

• Strong understanding of core HR disciplines and employment practices

• Experience working in an international and matrix-based organisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join a global organisation where people, leadership and business performance are closely connected. You will work with experienced leaders, influence strategic people agendas and contribute to shaping the future organisation across Strategic Marketing and International Sales.

Ready to join Demant Diagnostic’s HR team?

**Would you like to lead the development of cutting-edge audiology that improves life for millions of people with hearing loss worldwide?

**In this role, you will work at the heart of Demant’s innovation, leading the group that creates the world-leading audiological technology used across Demant hearing aids.

• Lead and develop an organization of 75 developers and leaders responsible for one of Demant’s core deliveries: world-leading audiology for Demant hearing solutions.

• Lead and develop leaders, providing clear direction and an inclusive environment where people can contribute and grow.

• Be accountable for R&D delivery through your leadership team and organization.

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is an advanced systems and industrialization company developing integrated technology platforms for demanding aerospace, security, and mission-critical applications. Its mission is to transform operationally validated technologies into scalable, ready-to-deploy systems by combining advanced engineering, industrial partnerships, and strong governance.

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development. The site will build core capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, industrialization, and deployment of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be an advanced aerospace signal-intelligence product platform covering RF and system architecture, antenna-system design, RF and microwave hardware, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for qualification, production, and operational deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and international deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s mechanical design capability for antenna and RF systems. The role is intended for an experienced mechanical engineer with prior hands-on experience developing the mechanical implementation of antenna, RF, or microwave hardware.

You will design and develop mechanical solutions for antenna systems and associated RF and electronic assemblies. The work includes antenna supports and mounts, RF-aware enclosures, radomes, fixed and, where applicable, deployable antenna mechanisms, test fixtures, thermal solutions, connector integration, cable routing, sealing, environmental protection, and platform interfaces. Many of these structures can directly affect antenna and RF performance, requiring close co-design with antenna and RF engineers.

The role covers mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing-process selection, structural and thermal analysis, tolerance definition, detailed CAD design, prototyping, assembly, environmental validation, serviceability, and production release. Particular attention will be given to mechanical structures that directly affect antenna performance, integration, alignment, stability, and deployment.

You will work closely with antenna systems engineers, RF and microwave hardware engineers, system architects, RF test and characterization engineers, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams. The role requires strong mechanical design expertise, RF-aware product thinking, end-to-end technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototype build and qualification to documented, manufacturable antenna assemblies and integrated systems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system, antenna, and platform requirements into mechanical architectures, interface definitions, design constraints, and technical trade-offs.

• Design mechanical components and assemblies for antenna systems, including supports, mounts, frames, radomes, RF-aware enclosures, fixed or deployable mechanisms, and platform-integration structures.

• Own the detailed mechanical implementation of antenna and RF assemblies, including 3D CAD models, 2D manufacturing drawings, GD&T, assembly-level tolerance analysis, BOMs, and configuration-controlled documentation.

• Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance.

• Integrate RF modules, antennas, electronics, connectors, cables, gaskets, thermal interfaces, and environmental sealing into complete mechanical assemblies.

• Perform structural, thermal, and tolerance analyses covering stiffness, strength, mass properties, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, and expected environmental loads.

• Define mechanical requirements and work jointly with antenna and RF engineers to establish electromagnetic constraints for radomes, covers, supports, enclosures, and other structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Design antenna deployment and positioning mechanisms, where applicable, including hinges, latches, restraints, stops, alignment features, and associated interfaces.

• Design test fixtures, alignment tools, handling aids, assembly tooling, and prototype-support hardware for antenna and RF system development.

• Select materials, coatings, surface treatments, fasteners, adhesives, seals, bearings, and manufacturing processes based on structural, thermal, RF, environmental, corrosion, and production requirements.

• Lead mechanical prototype build, assembly, troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Contribute to environmental testing and qualification, including vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, and other relevant mechanical validation activities.

• Apply design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly, serviceability, reliability, and cost considerations throughout development.

• Work with suppliers and manufacturing partners on technical clarification, process selection, prototype production, inspection, non-conformance resolution, and production release.

• Prepare mechanical specifications, analysis reports, interface-control documentation, design-review materials, assembly instructions, and production handover documentation.

• Collaborate with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and engineering workflows for the Copenhagen design site.

Required qualifications and experience

• Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 5+ years of professional mechanical design experience, including demonstrated experience developing mechanical hardware for antenna, RF, or microwave systems where mechanical geometry, materials, interfaces, tolerances, or nearby structures directly influence electromagnetic performance.

• Strong hands-on experience and demonstrated technical ownership of complex mechanical assemblies from initial architecture and concept through detailed design, prototype build, verification, qualification, and production release.

• Advanced proficiency with a professional 3D CAD and drafting environment; SolidWorks experience is preferred.

• Strong command of GD&T, engineering drawing standards, assembly-level tolerance analysis, and production-quality mechanical documentation.

• Demonstrated experience designing mechanical components or assemblies for antenna, RF, or microwave systems, such as antenna supports and mounts, frames, enclosures, radomes, mechanisms, fixtures, or other mechanically and electromagnetically constrained structures.

• Experience with mechanical packaging and integration of antennas, RF modules, PCBs, connectors, cables, thermal interfaces, shielding, grounding, seals, and associated electronics.

• Practical understanding of RF-aware mechanical design, including the effects of materials, structures, clearances, alignment, grounding, shielding, cabling, and radomes on antenna and RF performance.

• Experience applying engineering calculations and simulation methods, including finite-element analysis where appropriate, to support structural and thermal design decisions.

• Understanding of stiffness, strength, thermal expansion, heat transfer, vibration, shock, fatigue, and other relevant environmental loads.

• Practical knowledge of metallic materials, engineering polymers, elastomers, composites, adhesives, coatings, and surface treatments.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as precision machining, sheet-metal fabrication, additive manufacturing, composite manufacturing, joining, fastening, sealing, and assembly.

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with prototype assembly, mechanical troubleshooting, design verification, and iterative improvement.

• Experience supporting environmental testing and qualification, such as vibration, shock, thermal cycling, ingress protection, or comparable validation activities.

• Experience working with suppliers and manufacturing teams on process selection, technical clarification, inspection, non-conformance resolution, manufacturability, and production handover.

Nice to have

• Experience developing lightweight, stiffness-critical structures with stringent alignment and dimensional-stability requirements.

• Experience with aerospace or space-hardware qualification, including thermal-vacuum testing, outgassing constraints, vibration, and shock.

• Experience with precision mechanical alignment, dimensional inspection, antenna positioning, and calibration or verification fixtures.

• Experience designing IP-rated enclosures or ruggedized outdoor electronic equipment.

• Experience with product data management, configuration control, and release processes for complex mechanical assemblies.

• Experience working with international suppliers and manufacturing partners on low-volume, high-complexity hardware.

• Experience designing radomes, RF-transparent structures, or mechanical structures located within or near the antenna field.

• Experience with mechanically steerable, deployable, foldable, or position-critical antenna systems.

• Experience working directly with antenna or electromagnetic simulation engineers to iterate mechanical geometry, materials, and interfaces based on RF performance.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take end-to-end technical ownership of one or more mechanical subsystems or integration areas for antenna and RF systems.

• Establish the initial mechanical architecture, material and manufacturing approach, and platform-integration plan for the assigned scope.

• Deliver reviewed 3D models, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analyses, interface definitions, and supporting design documentation.

• Develop and support the build, assembly, and verification of initial mechanical prototypes, fixtures, or engineering models.

• Identify key structural, thermal, alignment, sealing, deployment, and manufacturability risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with antenna, RF and microwave hardware, system, test, electronics, manufacturing, supplier, and partner engineering teams.

• Help establish mechanical design standards, CAD practices, documentation templates, and release workflows for the Copenhagen design site.
